scope: Global climate-finance context plus a Colombia-oriented capital-system map
method_note: Global KPI values are source-derived. Sankey link weights are qualitative visual-emphasis weights for the financing system and are not measured monetary flows.

global_snapshot.label: Global climate finance
global_snapshot.note: Climate finance surpassed US$2 trillion for the first time in 2024.

global_snapshot.label: Estimated global climate finance
global_snapshot.note: CPI estimates global climate finance reached approximately US$2.1 trillion in 2025.

global_snapshot.label: Mitigation finance
global_snapshot.note: Mitigation remained the dominant climate-finance use in 2024.

global_snapshot.label: Adaptation finance
global_snapshot.note: Tracked adaptation investment plateaued at approximately US$64 billion in 2024.
